product.name: Sanfang Qixiang City Walk Experience
core_selling_points: Sanfang Qixiang as a recognizable Fuzhou cultural landmark
Absurd NiuLai and original Hujiu teaser style for young short-video audiences
A 15-second story hook that turns city-walk tourism into a shareable mini trailer

audience: 18-30 year-old young travelers, local city-walk users, and Douyin users interested in trendy cultural tourism
brand_tone: young, playful, absurd, culturally rooted, trailer-like, tourism-friendly

must_show.destination: Sanfang Qixiang must be recognizable as the core tourism destination.
must_show.characters: NiuLai and original Hujiu-style absurd teaser elements should appear as the creative hook after reference assets are available.
copy: Sanfang Qixiang has only six lanes left
The seventh lane is just on shift break

prohibited: Do not invent a physical drink product, packaging, or official co-branded logo.
Do not imply official government endorsement beyond the demo's tourism campaign framing.
Do not use unconfirmed logos, unlicensed brand marks, or fake official seals.
Do not use unsafe, violent, politically sensitive, or horror imagery.
Do not make Sanfang Qixiang look like a generic non-Chinese city street.
cta: Go to Sanfang Qixiang and find the seventh lane
objective: Create a 15-second vertical Douyin absurd tourism teaser that proves DreamPipe can turn a structured brief into storyboard, generation, QA, failed-shot retry, and final output.
constraints: MVP uses one tourism destination experience, three shots, one video model, and one CTA.
The demo must show input brief, storyboard, generation, QA, failed-shot retry, and final output.
At least one shot should intentionally fail QA first, then pass after prompt repair and retry.
Use the same project_id for project_bible.json, shots.json, and generation_result.json.
Position 2 should not write model-specific prompts in shots.json; prompts are produced by Position 3's Prompt Compiler.
